A_SPLIT_BILL_PRO.calculation: Use integer VND arithmetic. Show each person's allocation; distribute remainder dong deterministically so allocations sum exactly to the bill. State that the bill is user-entered and no unproven discount or fee is applied.
A_SPLIT_BILL_PRO.share_behavior: On explicit click, copy an invitation containing the total bill, group size, per-person amount or allocation and a working canonical detail URL or stable card anchor. Explain that the text is ready to paste into Zalo; do not claim that a message was sent.

B_SEVEN_DAY_SAVINGS_TIMELINE.placement: Seven day controls near the top of the homepage, Monday through Sunday
B_SEVEN_DAY_SAVINGS_TIMELINE.behavior: Selecting a day filters eligible cards immediately and displays selected-day state and result count. Combine predictably with existing search/category filters and provide an explicit reset.

monday: Metiz Super Monday — 55K if current evidence supports the price and conditions
tuesday: ShopeePay offers where the published date and eligibility permit
wednesday: CGV Culture Day only on the exact dates or recurrence established by source evidence
thursday_through_sunday: Student lunches where verified availability supports display

B_SEVEN_DAY_SAVINGS_TIMELINE.evidence_rule: Editorial mappings are requested targets, not proof of weekly recurrence. Bind each offer to source-backed dates, weekday rules, expiry and conditions. Do not turn Culture Day into every Wednesday or an app promotion into every Tuesday without evidence. Generic service availability must be labeled separately from a discount.
B_SEVEN_DAY_SAVINGS_TIMELINE.missing_evidence: Show an honest empty or unverified-schedule state and list missing evidence in the receipt; do not invent an offer, date or price.
B_SEVEN_DAY_SAVINGS_TIMELINE.performance: Measure click-to-visible-filter-update using browser timing and the next painted frame. Target p95 below 50 ms over at least 30 day switches after warm-up for each viewport; report actual values, browser and hardware/emulation conditions.
acceptance: Verify all seven controls, result membership, empty state, reset and interaction with existing filters.
Verify expired offers and date-specific campaigns do not appear as active recurring deals.
Verify keyboard focus, selected state and accessible result announcements.
